definition: Establishing correspondences between images of the same scene — feature matching and detector-free matchers underpin SfM and SLAM.
details: Establishing correspondences between images of the same scene — feature matching and detector-free matchers underpin SfM and SLAM.

explainer.lead: Image matching establishes correspondences between images of the same scene. It underpins structure-from-motion and SLAM.

tiers.eli5: Like spotting the same landmark in two holiday photos so you know which parts show the same place.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers rely on feature matchers and detector-free matchers to link pixels across views; a common pitfall is correspondences that fail under large viewpoint or appearance changes.
tiers.paperLevel: Establishing correspondences between images of the same scene; feature matching and detector-free matchers underpin SfM and SLAM.

explainer.example: Finding corresponding points between two images of the same scene to support structure-from-motion.
